title: Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.27855v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anchor tokens let a vision transformer exchange global information through a few summaries, but nothing forces different anchors to summarise different things. On one shared backbone we show that a Perceiver-style pathway and an AnchorFormer pathway collapse to a single summary, the latter despite its mass normalisation (pooling-map similarity 0.99), while other soft pathways, including Representative Attention, stay partly redundant (0.59-0.79). These results concern the routing modules inside our block, not the full published models. An exclusive partition of the patch grid cannot collapse by construction, and matched component by component it is 2.4-3.6 points more accurate than Representative Attention on CIFAR-100. We then propose focus anchors, which place most anchors at the peaks of a learned importance map while all anchors keep one exclusive Voronoi partition. translated_title: 不坍缩而移动的锚点：面向视觉Transformer的独占区域锚点路由
translated_abstract: 锚点token让视觉Transformer能够通过少数摘要来交换全局信息，但没有任何机制强制不同的锚点去摘要不同的内容。在同一个共享骨干网络上，我们证明Perceiver式路径和AnchorFormer路径会坍缩为单一摘要——即使后者带有质量归一化也是如此（池化图相似度达0.99）——而其他软性路径，包括代表性注意力，仍然部分冗余（0.59-0.79）。这些结果涉及我们模块内部的路由模块，而非已发表的完整模型。对图像块网格的独占划分在构造上不可能坍缩，在逐组件匹配的条件下，它在CIFAR-100上比代表性注意力的准确率高2.4-3.6个百分点。随后，我们提出焦点锚点，它将大多数锚点放置在习得的重要性图的峰值处，同时所有锚点保持一个独占的Voronoi划分。焦点锚点在杂乱画布场景中优于固定划分（+1.5个点……）
tldr: 该论文提出面向视觉Transformer的独占区域锚点路由机制，让每个锚点持有互不重叠的Voronoi区域从构造上杜绝锚点摘要坍缩，并结合焦点锚点将锚点置于习得重要性图的峰值处，从而显著提升分类精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes exclusive-region anchor routing for vision transformers, where each anchor holds a non-overlapping Voronoi partition that prevents summary collapse by construction, combined with focus anchors placed at the peaks of a learned importance map to improve accuracy.
